Looking at this properly, the question is about the function of the text. A catalogue essay is not a comfort object; it is a record of evidence. Adding a warm, reassuring aside that changes nothing is like applying a varnish that doesn’t protect the paint but just makes it look shinier for a moment. It obscures the surface. It is noise.
